lines: One June evening, on the last ferry back from Capri.
He was sitting in my seat. I kept the ticket.
Six summers, two passports and one very old scooter later…
… he asked me on the steps above the harbour.
Now we would love to have you with us for what comes next.
One long day, in four acts.

items.title: Aperitivo
items.detail: on the terrace, facing the sea

lines: Come by ferry if you can — it is the prettiest way in.

info.title: Where to stay
info.body: We have held a block of rooms in the village, a ten-minute walk from the villa. Mention it in your reply and we will send you the booking code.

info.title: What to wear
info.body: Summer formal, bright colours very welcome. The garden is on several levels, so leave the thin heels at home.

info.title: Getting there
info.body: Naples airport, then the ferry from Sorrento. A shuttle leaves the port for the villa at 3 pm and takes everyone back at midnight.

info.title: Children
info.body: Bring them. There is a shaded corner with games and a very patient dog during dinner.
